Messagedelambassadeur.title: Message from the Ambassador
Messagedelambassadeur.text1: Dear visitors, welcome to the official website of the Embassy of Burkina Faso in New Delhi. We are committed to strengthening the bonds between our nations and providing dedicated support to our citizens abroad.
Messagedelambassadeur.text2: Our mission is to foster diplomatic, economic, and cultural cooperation between Burkina Faso and India. We work tirelessly to protect the interests of Burkinabe citizens while promoting mutual understanding and collaboration.
Messagedelambassadeur.text3: In these challenging times, our embassy remains fully operational to assist nationals and facilitate international partnerships. We encourage you to explore our services and stay informed through our official channels.
Messagedelambassadeur.text4: Together, we build a stronger future rooted in solidarity, respect, and shared prosperity.

ambassador.title: The Ambassador
ambassador.photo_alt: Portrait of H.E. Dr. Désiré Boniface Somé, Ambassador of Burkina Faso to India
bio: H.E. Dr. Désiré Boniface Somé assumed his role as Head of Mission in New Delhi on August 29, 2023. A distinguished academic and Associate Professor of Sociology from the University Joseph Ki-Zerbo, Dr. Somé combines high-level research expertise with a strategic vision for South-South cooperation.

His mission focuses on three strategic pillars: strengthening economic partnerships in mining, textile, and pharmaceutical sectors; facilitating technology transfer to enhance Burkina Faso's agriculture and industry; and fostering educational exchange and professional training for Burkinabè youth.

In addition to India, Dr. Somé oversees diplomatic relations with Indonesia, Thailand, and Nepal, working to position Burkina Faso as a key partner for development and cultural exchange across the region.

embassy.title: About the Embassy
embassy.desc1: The Embassy of Burkina Faso in New Delhi is the official diplomatic mission of Burkina Faso to the Republic of India. The Embassy serves as the primary channel for diplomatic, consular, and commercial relations between the two countries.
embassy.desc2: The Embassy provides a full range of consular services to Burkinabè nationals residing in or traveling through India, Indonesia, Thailand, and Nepal. Services include passport and visa processing, civil status documentation, and emergency assistance.

network.title: Consular Network
network.desc: The Embassy's jurisdiction includes three honorary consulates: Mumbai (Maharashtra, India), Bangkok (Thailand), and Jakarta (Indonesia). The Bangkok and Jakarta consulates are currently operational with appointed Honorary Consuls.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about consular services and embassy procedures.

items.q1: Why should I register with the consulate?
a1: The vast majority of Burkinabè nationals traveling abroad encounter no difficulties. However, given our mission, we are able to assist Burkinabè nationals who are victims of criminal acts, accidents, illness, death, natural or man-made disasters, civil unrest, or whose family needs to reach them in an emergency.
If you request a service from the Embassy or consulate abroad, staff will ask you to provide proof of Burkinabè citizenship, such as a passport or identity card.
By registering your trip online, you help location services in case of emergency, verify your status, and facilitate communication with your family or relatives.
Registration is voluntary and free of charge. We encourage you to consider registration as an integral part of your travel planning and safety.
a2: The Consular Card is an identity document issued by the Embassy to registered Burkinabè citizens within its jurisdiction. All citizens of Burkina Faso are entitled to receive a consular card.
To obtain a Consular Card, register with the Embassy by presenting any document proving Burkinabè citizenship (passport, identity card, etc.).
items.q3: How can the Embassy or Consulate help me while abroad?
a3: Consular services are provided to Burkinabè nationals who work, live, and travel abroad. Consular services operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A detailed list of services is available on our Consular Services page.
items.q4: How will my information be used?
a4: The Consulate at Burkina Faso missions abroad will use your protected information if necessary in the event of a disaster, emergency, or any other crisis.

Only authorized Consulate officials have access to the information, which will only be used in case of disaster, emergency, or other crisis. This enables authorized officials to respond — for example, to contact family members to verify the status of Burkinabè nationals traveling abroad who may have been affected by the emergency.
a5: The Consulate is committed to ensuring that any personal information received through the online registration process is protected from unauthorized disclosure.

The Consulate will not disclose the information you provide during the registration process to third parties (including family members) unless you have previously given written authorization to do so. In the event that family members inquire about your whereabouts, such requests will be forwarded to you. You may choose to inform the Consulate of your decision to respond or not to respond.
a6: A citizen of a foreign country who seeks to enter Burkina Faso must generally first obtain a visa, which is placed in the traveler's passport — a travel document issued by the traveler's country of citizenship.

Some international travelers may be eligible to travel to Burkina Faso without a visa if they meet the requirements for visa-free travel. Please visit our Visa Services page for complete details on visa categories, requirements, and fees.
